scope: Concert and live-music chronology audit; this is a private evidence ledger, not visitor publication approval
distinctions: Existing user-reported attendance is preserved; third-party setlists and venue listings corroborate the show, not who attended.
2007 Lollapalooza is one August 3–5 event; user's three-day visit does not establish seeing every listed artist.
Historical 2007 Red Hot Chili Peppers venue name is Assembly Hall; State Farm Center is the subsequent name.
Some concert records represent combined sporting/running events; cross-linking to sports/adventures should not create duplicated attendances.
No concerts have been inferred from gaps in calendar years. The collection may be incomplete, especially early and middle years.
Companions, standout songs, and first-person recollections remain to be enriched; do not manufacture them from concert setlists.

Attendance at Hawthorne Heights during UIUC freshman year is confirmed firsthand. November 10, 2006 Assembly Hall is an independently documented local show but is NOT promoted to the user's exact date or auditorium without corresponding ticket/photo evidence.
